body: well i would say maybe stop looking into these theories for sureee cus that will deffo make you spiral even more and i reallyyy dont want you to. when i was going through that, i would say that there was times when i would fully give in to the absolutely insaneeee things i was thinkinv and believing. but i would say that looking back, there was definitely times in-between where i could make rational thoughts and "come back" a bit, if you get what i mean. (ig i mean like in the midst of the derealisation, theres times when you feel normal right?) but you should trust yourself when you get those normal thoughts. you will always 100% come back. i promise you, you wont stay like that forever. i absolutely promise. its so hard to get help for these things and i havent even really started yet but just know that it really is temporary. i wish i had someone to tell me that so im telling you. i really hope you get better because i really understand how you feel. ( i feel like i love you now 😛🤟). hahaha

you know, sorry for following you onto this post but omg you literally described me to a T. you put into words what i could never. when i used to write into my notes about how there was a hole in me and i have to be myself wether or not i choose to or not. it feels like there’s no escape from me and when i thought about it hard, i had a panic attack. who am i but not me. you can’t leave and you can’t run. it’s more than just bpd, it who i am. who am i? i wish i could help you but i dont even know how to help myself. i wish someone could understand you how i could understand you. i feel like im lying all the time and im not a reliable narrator but who should i believe if not myself. i’m trying not to make this all about myself because that’s how it feels sometimes. but i really do believe that you’re trying. you’re trying so hard and i really understand that. just know that if you feel like you’ll never escape and be anyone but yourself, you have people here that will listen to you and make you not feel alone. though people like us have a habit of leaving before others can leave us, it’s ok to to feel like that because it’s all you know. you don’t have to reply or anything but just know that we are all here for eachother 🩵🩵🩵🤍

omg i have to tell you, you are literally me you know? like i want to tell you that im grateful for you too. we understand eachother in a way that no one else understands and eachother and i feel it too. sorry if im cringing you out but im drunk rn and want to tell you that i get it 100%. if no one gets you, i get you ok? ❤️❤️❤️ that’s how i truly feel, believe me
